image_description: A studio shot of four translucent plastic ring binders arranged in two rows against a white background. The top row features a cream/white binder and a magenta binder, both standing upright with spines facing left. The bottom row features a light blue binder lying flat (spine left) and a yellow binder lying flat (spine right). All binders show visible metal ring mechanisms on the spine side.
